description: The image shows Extended Logic (a database/SQL client application) on Windows with a dark theme. The left panel displays a SQL query editor with highlighted code including SELECT statements with joins on tables like "table_sizes", "table_sizes_view", and references to "time_created" columns. There's also a pink comment block with SQL code. On the right side, a dark terminal/console window displays execution output showing "Breakdown:" followed by PRE queries (Scv1_135_Final_1.4Dply01) with 2 quarters, POST queries with 14 quarters, and a summary line stating "Total processed this time - 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 quarters." The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing various application icons including File Explorer, Chrome, and other utilities, with the time showing 5:47 AM.

The image shows Extended Logic IDE (visible in the window title bar at top left) with a SQL query editor on the left side displaying code that includes table operations with variables like `s_table_name`, `FROM times s left join source e`, and statements including `select`, `table_name`, `table_count`, `table_type_created`, along with highlighted syntax for SQL keywords. On the right side, there's a dark terminal/console window showing execution results with a "Breakdown" section listing "PRE queries," "POST queries" with dates (2022-Sep22-Oct22 format), and a summary line stating "Total processed this time - 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries." The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing the time as 9:21 AM, and the user appears to be reviewing query execution results after running a database processing script.

The image shows a Windows desktop with DBeaver (database management tool) open on the left side, displaying SQL code in an editor with syntax highlighting. The SQL query visible includes `SELECT` statements with `table_size`, `table_name`, `time_created` columns and references to tables like `pg_size_pretty` and what appears to be PostgreSQL system catalog queries. On the right side, there's a dark terminal/console window showing script output with a "Breakdown" section listing "PRE queries: %s22 - 2 quarters" and "POST queries: %s22 (through %s22 inclusive)" along with dated entries from 2022-Jul through 2022-Aug, ending with a summary line "Total processed this time: 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries". The user appears to be reviewing database migration or query execution results, with the cursor positioned in the terminal output area.

The screenshot shows DBeaver database management application with a SQL query editor on the left side containing a SELECT query joining tables (visible SQL includes "FROM hive x LEFT JOIN some_source a" and selecting columns like "table_size, table_rows, table_name, time_created"). On the right side, there is a dark terminal/console output window displaying execution results with a "Breakdown:" section showing "PRE queries" and "POST queries" with timestamps (2022-Jul-2-Jul22 and similar date patterns), and a final status line reading "Total processed this time - 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 queries". The user appears to be reviewing the results of a database query execution, with the Windows taskbar visible at the bottom showing this is running on Windows with Chrome, File Explorer, and other applications in the taskbar.

The image shows DBeaver database IDE on the left side with a SQL query editor containing a SELECT statement that joins tables using "FROM tiles a LEFT JOIN some_source b ON a.table_name = b.table_name" with filters on table_type and table_schema. On the right side is a terminal window displaying script output showing a "Breakdown" section with "PRE queries: 2 quarters" and "POST quarters 3q22 through 3q25 (inclusive)" followed by a list of quarters (2022-3q22, 2022-4q22, etc.) and ending with "Total processed this time: 2 PRE + 14 POST = 16 quarters". The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing the time as 9:02 AM, and the user appears to be reviewing the results of a data processing script that handles quarterly data.
